name: cognitive_interface_erosion
label: The Fading Command
godotFeature: Control nodes with ShaderMaterial, _gui_input handling, and ViewportTexture
poeticVision: Feel the information that guides your survival literally fray and dissolve under the Silence's unseen assault, forcing desperate, split-second decisions not just in the world, but on the very interface you rely upon. Experience the terror of forgetting how to fight, how to heal, how to *be*, as critical commands bleed out of existence.
usage: Attach this script to any Control node (e.g., TextureRect, Label) that represents a critical UI element. Assign a new ShaderMaterial to the Control node's 'Material' property, then load the 'cognitive_interface_erosion.gdshader' into the ShaderMaterial's 'Shader' property. Set a 'decay_texture' (e.g., a noise or grunge texture) in the ShaderMaterial's uniforms. Call 'start_decay()' on the script instance from your game logic (e.g., when the player takes damage or a memory-eroding event occurs) to initiate the visual degradation. The player must then rapidly click/tap the UI element 'stabilization_taps_required' times within 'stabilization_window_time' to reset the decay. Failure to stabilize will result in the UI element becoming fully decayed and non-interactive.

parameters.name: decay_rate
parameters.description: The speed at which the UI element visually decays per second (0.0 to 1.0).

parameters.name: stabilization_taps_required
parameters.description: The number of rapid clicks/taps needed to stabilize the decaying UI element.

parameters.name: stabilization_window_time
parameters.description: The time window (in seconds) within which the required taps must be performed to stabilize the UI.

dependencies: Texture2D resource (for the 'decay_texture' uniform in the shader)
verdict: As the interface itself crumbles, the player's fight for survival becomes a desperate struggle against the very act of forgetting.
impact: This mechanic transforms the user interface from a passive information display into an active, dynamic battlefield. Players will not only contend with external threats but also fight a constant, visceral battle against the decay of their own capabilities and knowledge. It forces desperate, split-second decisions not just in combat, but on the very tools they rely upon, making the act of 'remembering how to play' a core, high-stakes challenge that deepens the theme of identity loss and the terror of forgetting.
